page_title: MON 1-3 WOL | B. Monchengladbach v Wolfsburg 13/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' B. Monchengladbach quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

90+4' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a projectile from close range to the left side of the goal, but Kamil Grabara makes a nice save.
90+2' B. Monchengladbach have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for B. Monchengladbach. B. Monchengladbach earn a corner.
90+1' Daniel Bauer prepares a substitution. Christian Eriksen is replaced by Pharell Hensel (Wolfsburg).
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Yannick Gerhardt walks off the pitch to be replaced by Vini Souza (Wolfsburg).
89' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
88' The foul by Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) was seen by Patrick Ittrich who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Wolfsburg have a free kick.
86' Wael Mohya (B. Monchengladbach) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
84' Grant-Leon Ranos (B. Monchengladbach) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
83' Daniel Bauer has decided to make a change. Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) replaces Lovro Majer.
83' A substitution has been made. Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) goes off and Dzenan Pejcinovic comes on.
80' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
79' Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) fires a brilliant shot from the edge of the box, but the effort rattles the right post! It could have been a superb goal.
77' One of the players from Wolfsburg times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
76' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player.
73' Celebrations are cut short for B. Monchengladbach as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
73' Wait! Referee Patrick Ittrich has indicated he is going to review the B. Monchengladbach goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
73' The attendance for today's match is 47161.
72' Goal! Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 2:3.
70' Substitution. Shuto Machino leaves the pitch and is replaced by Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach).
70' Eugen Polanski decides to make a substitution. Luca Netz will be replaced by Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach).
68' Substitution. Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is replaced by Mattias Svanberg.
67' Good work from Wolfsburg as they win a corner.
65' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Wolfsburg due to an offside in the build-up play.
65' The Wolfsburg players halt their celebrations as referee Patrick Ittrich makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
64' Goal! Sael Kumbedi puts the ball across the area and Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 1:4.
61' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) fires a shot from close range, but he is somehow only able to hit the left post!
60' Patrick Ittrich blows for a foul after Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. B. Monchengladbach have a free kick from a promising distance.
57' Eugen Polanski has decided to substitute Giovanni Reyna and he is replaced by Wael Mohya (B. Monchengladbach).
57' The manager makes a subsitution with Grant-Leon Ranos (B. Monchengladbach) coming on for Jens Castrop.
56' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
55' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Kamil Grabara makes a comfortable save.
52' B. Monchengladbach take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
52' A cross from Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball is out of play and B. Monchengladbach manage to earn a corner.
51' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.

50' Giovanni Reyna (B. Monchengladbach) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. A free kick to Wolfsburg.

47' Giovanni Reyna (B. Monchengladbach) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick is awarded to Wolfsburg.
46' Referee Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' The ball goes behind for a corner. B. Monchengladbach will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
43' Moritz Nicolas makes a brilliant save! Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper low into the middle of the goal.
43' A player from Wolfsburg commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. Free kick. B. Monchengladbach will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
41' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to outfox the defender, but he only tricks himself after getting caught in the offside trap.
40' Patrick Ittrich blows the whistle, Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is penalised for a foul. B. Monchengladbach earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.

38' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
34' 1 - 3 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom left corner. Good team effort!
30' 1 - 2 Goal! Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the middle of the net. He makes it 1:2.
28' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) was quite harsh and Patrick Ittrich didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
28' Wolfsburg force a corner. They send men into the box.
27' The corner is swung in but Wolfsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Wolfsburg are awarded a corner kick.
26' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Moritz Nicolas comes off the line to clear the ball away. The referee signals a corner kick to Wolfsburg.
25' A player from B. Monchengladbach brings down an opponent and commits a foul. Wolfsburg are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
23' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and B. Monchengladbach players have a reason to celebrate!
23' Wait! Referee Patrick Ittrich has indicated he is going to review the B. Monchengladbach goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
22' 1 - 1 An unfortunate moment for Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg), who has scored an own goal.
19' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach) heads on.
18' B. Monchengladbach can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

18' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for B. Monchengladbach.
17' Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.

16' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) gets inside the box and tries to beat Moritz Nicolas with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
10' Handball! A player from Wolfsburg handled the ball. That's a free kick to B. Monchengladbach.
8' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
4' 0 - 1 Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) converts a killer cross with a powerful low shot that goes into the middle of the net.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Wolfsburg will have the kick-off.
Patrick Ittrich will supervise the game today.
